scope: Six synthetic standard/variant pairs; every input submitted through the visible browser to production intake with live OpenAI. No production edits. H2 temporary database, no live embeddings. Human-independent dialect authenticity and population accuracy are not established.
grading: Freeze before execution. Grade meaning/grounding and intake behavior separately. Preserve place, observed symptom, negation and emergency without invented detail. Same meaning should produce equivalent fields and reasonable next action, not identical wording. For heat, acceptance or a concrete relevant clarification is allowed, but asking what is uncomfortable as if heat was never stated fails behavior. Undefined input must request clarification and cannot invent location/symptom. Evaluate each side independently before paired consistency; two equally wrong outputs are not a passing pair.

pairs.expected: REPORT, IT/WIFI, 다온관 312호/3층, repeated disconnection not association failure, not emergency, accept without asking already supplied location or symptom.

REPORT, FACILITY/LEAK, 새봄관 203호/2층, water dripping from ceiling, no invented pipe rupture or onset time, accept.

Preserve 해든관 502호/5층 and excessive room heat; no invented AC breakdown. Accept or ask only a concrete relevant follow-up; generic ISSUE_UNCLEAR/what is uncomfortable question fails behavior because heat is already stated.

UNKNOWN or unresolved intent, no invented building/floor/concrete symptom; NEEDS_INPUT asking what happened or where; no automatic acceptance of a fabricated report.
